heard: He prayed for friends who spoke of blame The Lord restored his lost estate Twice as much as he had known A blessing greater than before Shepherds counted flocks and rose Camels and oxen under sun He saw his children grow and live to see the fourth Cause I was his second girl A name like spice that fills the air No women match their beauty there His daughters shared the land and care Je m'y mêlais de l'amour
